name: costgoblin
description: Desktop app for cloud cost visibility
author: Etienne Chabert <etienne.chabert.de@gmail.com>

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && eslint packages/core/src/ packages/ui/src/ packages/desktop/src/ packages/mcp/src/ && vitest run
scripts.e2e: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/views-core.test.ts e2e/views-config.test.ts e2e/views-defaults.test.ts e2e/stress.test.ts e2e/workspaces.test.ts e2e/gcp-provider.test.ts e2e/csp-verification.test.ts e2e/sandbox-verification.test.ts && npx tsx e2e/collect-coverage.ts
scripts.e2e:security: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/csp-verification.test.ts e2e/sandbox-verification.test.ts
scripts.e2e:workspaces: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/workspaces.test.ts
scripts.e2e:core: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/views-core.test.ts && npx tsx e2e/collect-coverage.ts
scripts.e2e:defaults: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/views-defaults.test.ts && npx tsx e2e/collect-coverage.ts
scripts.e2e:config: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/views-config.test.ts && npx tsx e2e/collect-coverage.ts
scripts.e2e:stress: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/stress.test.ts
scripts.e2e:gcp: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/gcp-provider.test.ts
scripts.perf: npm run build --workspace=packages/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/perf.test.ts
